answer_text: To diagnose slow Internet, run a ping test and traceroute to compare latency for traffic that passes through Cato vs bypassing Cato. Sub-optimal routing is a common cause; if your results show higher latency through Cato, we’ll need to investigate the route. If you’re on Wi‑Fi, a weak client signal can also cause slow performance, so check signal strength (a reading around -75 dBm or lower can indicate trouble) and improve coverage or try a wired connection.
